source_locator.description: Muthayi takes the merchant's child to the seashore; a storm and heavy rain break; a tree falls and traps Muthayi while the child is separated.

translation.english_text: [Muthayi takes the merchant's child to the seashore. A storm rises. Heavy rain pours down. She comes running with the child!... A swaying tree breaks. Muthayi is trapped beneath the fallen tree. The child is separated and left alone.]
